description: productops.prd_sections: the judgement-bearing sections of a PRD from an approved proposal, inside the mid tier's output ceiling. The expectation pins that at least one non-goal is stated and that the first user story names the learner.

input.proposal: Spoken roleplay scenarios: let a learner run any existing roleplay by voice. Tutor lines read aloud via existing TTS, learner answers transcribed via existing STT, same turn pipeline and corrections. Plus and Premium only. Complexity medium.

userStories: As a Plus learner, I want to run a roleplay by voice, so that I rehearse speaking before a real situation.
As a learner, I want my spoken slips corrected the same way as in text, so that voice practice teaches as much.
functionalRequirements: A scenario thread can be started in voice mode on Plus and Premium
Each tutor line is read aloud through the existing text-to-speech route
Each learner reply is transcribed through the existing transcription route and sent through the turn pipeline
Voice quotas are counted per plan as they are for free-form chat
acceptanceCriteria: A Plus learner completes a scenario entirely by voice with corrections shown
A Free learner sees the voice option as locked, not broken
Each spoken turn is ledgered and quota-counted like a chat turn

userStories: As a Plus learner, I want to run a roleplay by voice, so that I rehearse speaking before a real situation.

input.proposal: Grammar patterns in spaced-repetition review: schedule a learner's recurring error patterns in the existing review queue with one example sentence each. Complexity small.

userStories: As a learner with a recurring error, I want it to come back in review, so that I practise it until it stops.
functionalRequirements: The review scheduler includes recurring grammar error patterns as items
A grammar item renders one example sentence and the corrected form
Marking a grammar item correct advances its interval like a word
acceptanceCriteria: A learner with one recurring error sees it in the next review session
The review page renders the grammar card without layout change for word cards
nonGoals: No new grammar explanations are generated by a model
No new grammar explanations are generated by a model

input.proposal: Spend by plan on the operator overview: break the cost dashboard's daily spend down by Free, Plus and Premium. Complexity small.

userStories: As an operator, I want daily spend split by plan, so that I can see whether Free is inside its budget.
functionalRequirements: The cost rollup records the learner's plan at the time of each call
The overview shows one series per plan on the spend chart
Totals per plan reconcile to the existing daily total
acceptanceCriteria: Per-plan totals sum to the daily total on every day shown
Operators without the second factor still see a 404
Per-plan totals sum to the daily total on every day shown
